title: Great Lift
wikitext:
{{Stub}}The '''Great Lift''' is a level 25-27 sub-region located in [[Kalimdor]] between the [[Barrens]] and [[Thousand Needles]]. The Great Lift carries people between the [[Barrens]] and the rocky floor of [[Thousand Needles]], far far below.

The two NPCs guarding the Great Lift, {{npclong|||Grish Longrunner|id=12576}} and {{npclong|||Brave Moonhorn|id=10079}}, will attack [[Alliance]] players on sight despite Moonhorn being a quest-giver and Longrunner being the recipient of a letter for {{quest|Calling in the Reserves|another quest}}. Most Alliance players who are of a high level enough to survive in the southern [[Barrens]] have no need to kill either NPC — it is pretty easy to simply run past them onto the ramps without being killed, merely hit a few times. Once an Alliance player steps onto the elevator platform, Moonhorn and/or Grish will stop attacking the player and run back up the ramp to their post. In addition, both guards will hesitate before attacking Alliance players who are a significantly higher level than they are (i.e. any player who sees the level numbers in the guards' portraits as grey).
